stale: Someone else changed this while you were editing it. Reload to see their changes, then make yours again.

deactivate.neverDeleted: Nothing is ever deleted: its history must be kept. Deactivating hides it from new work; you can reactivate it later.
deactivate.reasonTooShort: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.

fields.invalid_trn: A TRN is 15 digits starting with 100.
fields.invalid_phone: Write a valid phone number, e.g. 050 123 4567.
fields.kit_cost: A kit's cost is worked out from its components.

file.label: Excel file
file.hint: The filled template (.xlsx), at most 5 MB and 5,000 rows.
file.not_excel: This is not an Excel (.xlsx) file.
file.too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
file.too_many_rows: The file has more than 5,000 rows. Split it into smaller files.
file.wrong_template: The columns do not match the template. Download the template and use its headers.
file.empty: The file has no rows to import.

import.allOrNothing: Checking saves nothing. Importing saves every row together, or none: a file is never half-imported.

report.label: Problems found
report.ready_one: The file is ready: {count} row can be imported.
report.ready_other: The file is ready: {count} rows can be imported.
report.fix_one: {count} problem found. Fix it in Excel, then choose the file and check it again.
report.fix_other: {count} problems found. Fix them in Excel, then choose the file and check it again.

problems.invalid_code: Not a valid code (letters, digits, . _ - only)
problems.invalid_trn: A TRN is 15 digits starting with 100
problems.invalid_choice: Not one of the allowed values (see the Lists sheet)
problems.duplicate_in_file: Appears more than once in the file
problems.price_required: An item for sale needs a price above zero
problems.too_many_decimals: More decimals than the unit allows
problems.cost_needs_permission: Only the owner can set a purchase price
